# MyAnimeDex

> MyAnimeDex is a free anime tracker app for iPhone, iPad and Android. It tracks the episodes you watch, shows a weekly airing calendar in your time zone with episode reminders, and turns your watch history into ranked lists, XP and ranks. Available in 15 languages.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iOS 15.1 or later (iPhone, iPad) and Android. Free to download; optional Premium subscription; the free version shows ads.
- Languages: English, Turkish, Japanese, Russian, German, Arabic, Spanish, Portuguese, Indonesian, Hindi, French, Italian, Polish, Vietnamese and Thai.
- Anime data (titles, episodes, airing times, scores) comes from AniList.
- Import: bring an existing list over from MyAnimeList or AniList, with statuses, progress and scores.
- Guest mode: browse anime, the airing calendar and Arena without an account; sign in (Apple, Google or email) only to save.
- Lists sync across devices.

## Features

- Episode tracking: tap + after each episode; a show moves to Completed after its last episode.
- Airing calendar: weekly schedule in your own time zone, live countdowns, filter to your favorites, free reminders when a favorite airs.
- Ranked lists: drag to reorder, add a score and a one-line take, share lists and build them together with friends.
- Profile and XP: earn XP for completed anime, reviews, Arena and lists; climb ranks from Rookie to Kami; leaderboard.
- Dice: picks an anime you have not added yet, with score, genres and synopsis.
- Anime Arena: bracket tournaments in 20 categories (best opening, best villain, hidden gems and more) to crown a champion.
- Reviews, favorites, filters and sorting; dark and light theme.
- Premium: My Stats (genre and studio breakdown, ratings compared with the community), themes, avatar frames, profile banners, a Top 10 showcase, For You+ recommendations, tags and notes on list entries, reminder settings, My Week, add episodes to your phone calendar, cloud backup and export.

## Download

- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6758043488): MyAnimeDex for iPhone and iPad
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.myanimedex.app): MyAnimeDex for Android

## Pages

- [Home](https://myanimedex.com/): features, playable demos and download links
- [Top 100 Anime](https://myanimedex.com/anime/): the highest-rated anime, one page each
- [Anime seasons](https://myanimedex.com/season/): each season's anime with weekly air times in your time zone
- [MyAnimeList alternative](https://myanimedex.com/myanimelist-alternative): how to import a MyAnimeList or AniList list into MyAnimeDex
- [Contact](https://myanimedex.com/contact): support, bug reports and feature ideas
- [Privacy Policy](https://myanimedex.com/privacy): what data the app and website collect
- [Terms of Use](https://myanimedex.com/terms)
- [Delete Account](https://myanimedex.com/delete-account): how to delete your account and data
